full_prompt_en: A square botanical oil painting shows a small hummingbird hovering above a lush arrangement of pale and red flowers on a dark ledge. The background is an almost black olive field with faint warm brown variation, making the petals and bird stand forward. At the upper left, the hummingbird faces right, its narrow beak pointed toward the bouquet and its wings lifted in a blurred upward beat. Its pale golden throat and green-brown body catch a sliver of light. Near the center, a large ivory blossom opens toward the viewer, layered petals surrounding a soft yellow throat. A tall striped cream and rust flower rises at the upper right, while a salmon-red bloom opens at the lower left. Smaller white flowers, deep red blossoms, buds, and twisting green leaves fill the gaps between them. Several tendrils hang over the horizontal brown ledge across the lower quarter. The ledge itself is glossy at the top edge and darker beneath, grounding the abundant plant forms. Botanical details are finely observed: curled petals, small stamens, leaf veins, and subtle color gradients are all present without harsh outlining. The flowers emerge from deep shadow in a composition that is dense at the base and opens toward the hovering bird. Warm directional light from the upper left illuminates the ivory petals, bird, and striped flower, leaving foliage and background nearly black. The overall composition is lush and intimate, balancing delicate motion with carefully modeled floral color against velvety darkness.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形植物油画，一只小蜂鸟悬停在深色台面上繁盛的浅色与红色花束上方。背景近乎黑橄榄色，带微弱暖褐变化，使花瓣和鸟向前显出。左上方蜂鸟朝右，细长鸟喙指向花束，双翼在向上振动中带一点模糊。浅金色喉部和绿褐身体接住一线光。中央附近，一朵大象牙色花朝观者开放，层层花瓣围住柔黄花心。右上方一朵带奶油色与锈红条纹的高花升起，左下方一朵鲑红花绽开。较小白花、深红花、花苞和缠绕绿叶填满间隙。几根卷须垂过下方四分之一处的横向褐色台沿。台沿顶部略带光泽，下方较暗，为丰盛植物形体提供落点。植物细节观察精密：卷曲花瓣、小花蕊、叶脉与细微色彩渐变都有呈现，却没有生硬勾边。花朵从深影中浮出，底部密集，向悬停小鸟处敞开。暖调定向光从左上方照亮象牙花瓣、蜂鸟和条纹花，枝叶与背景近乎黑色。整体构图丰盛而贴近，以细腻动势平衡丝丝入扣的花色和柔软黑暗。
style_prompt_en: The botanical oil-paint treatment combines meticulous naturalistic detail with deep velvety shadow. Ivory, warm cream, salmon, burgundy, and muted gold blooms emerge from nearly black olive and brown masses. Petal edges are delicate and softly modeled; small veins, stamens, and leaf textures remain precise without thick outlines. A dense lower cluster rises toward a small airy accent, creating rhythm between abundance and open darkness. Warm upper-side light gives selected surfaces luminous volume, while stems and recessed foliage merge into shadow. The paint feels smooth in the blossoms and slightly textured in leaves and background. The result is lush, intimate, and dramatically quiet.
style_prompt_zh: 这种植物油画处理把精密自然主义细节与深而柔软的阴影结合。象牙、暖奶油、鲑红、酒红和低调金色花形从近黑的橄榄与褐色团块中浮出。花瓣边缘精巧且柔和塑形；小叶脉、花蕊与叶面肌理保持精确，却没有粗重轮廓。下方密集团簇向上方小型通透强调升起，形成丰盛与开放黑暗之间的节奏。上方一侧的暖光赋予选定表面明亮体积，茎与凹进枝叶则融入阴影。花朵上的颜料显得平滑，叶与背景略带肌理。效果丰盛、亲密，戏剧性地安静。
theme_en: A hummingbird hovering over pale and red flowers on a dark ledge
theme_zh: 蜂鸟悬停在深色台面上的浅色与红色花朵上方
name: Martin Johnson Heade
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
